content.scenario: The State Commission exercised administrative control over a District Commission outside its jurisdiction, directing it to dispose of a case in a particular manner.
content.outcome: The State Commission has administrative control over all District Commissions within its jurisdiction in all matters referred to in sub-section (1). The Commission's attempt to exercise control over a District Commission outside its jurisdiction is ultra vires and a violation of the provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What is the scope of administrative control of the State Commission?
Can the State Commission exercise control over District Commissions outside its jurisdiction?
What are the consequences of exceeding administrative control?
